steps: Identity: application quotes contract reference CW-2024-0417-CIV; this contract's reference is CW-2025-0417-CIV (Agreement p1, and every instrument S1-A3 pp39-43) -> contract_ref_variant. Subcontractor 'Ridgeway Civil Engineering LLC' matches the Agreement.
Term: work date 2025-06-10 within 2025-01-05 to 2026-09-30 (as twice extended, p38) -> in term.
Window: period 2025-06-10 to 2025-06-10; application date 2025-06-15 is not before the last day of the period and is 5 days after it (limit 21) -> in time; work date inside the stated period.
Unit: line m2 = Schedule 1 unit m2 for D.41.020 (p18) -> OK.
Record: D.41.020 is not in Schedule 5 (p27) -> no record required; empty record_ref is not a defect.

Rate in force: Schedule 1 base 63.50 (p18) is replaced for D.41.020 by Supplement No.1 cl.1.2 monthly rate (issued 2025-03-24, effective 2025-05-01, p39): June 2025 = 219.80. S2 (2025-12-01), A2 (2026-04-01) do not reach June 2025; A1 and A3 do not touch D.41.020 (p38). No retrospective instrument affects this date.
Not indexed (Sch 2A lists only C.31.010, D.41.030, p21); not USD (Sch 2B lists B.23.020, B.25.010, C.32.040, p22).

Build-up (Cl.27, p6): 219.80 x zone Z1 factor 1 (Series D listed, p20) = 219.80; ground factor n/a (D.41.020 not in Sch 3 list, p23); night uplift n/a (night_work N); rest-day uplift n/a (2025-06-10 is a Tuesday, and D.41.020 is not in Sch 4 Part 2, p24); band n/a (D.41.020 not in Sch 4 Part 3; state band_pct 100) -> 219.80.
Rounding (Cl.28, p6): 219.80 to nearest halala, half up -> 219.80.
Quantity: 100 m2 (no record or quantity rule limits it within this line's scope).
Priced value if the application were accepted under this contract: 100 x 219.80 = 21980.00.

Payability: the application does not identify itself as an application under Subcontract CW-2025-0417-CIV; Cl.48 obliges payment only of a correctly submitted application (p8) -> not payable as submitted: allowed_quantity 0, amount 0.00.
Billed rate 63.50 != 219.80 -> rate_differs. Billed arithmetic 100 x 63.50 = 6350.00 = billed amount -> no amount_arithmetic.

note: The contract has no clause expressly stating the consequence of a wrong contract reference on an application (Cl.42 does not list the contract reference among required content). Reading used: an application quoting CW-2024-0417-CIV is not a correctly submitted application under CW-2025-0417-CIV (Agreement p1, Cl.48 p8), so the line is not payable now; it becomes payable on resubmission. Alternative reading (reference treated as a clerical variant, subcontractor/site/work all matching this contract, Cl.42 not requiring the reference): payable true, allowed_quantity 100, amount 21980.00 (100 x 219.80). Either way the billed rate 63.50 (Schedule 1 base) is wrong for June 2025: Supplement No.1 monthly rate 219.80 applies. Band state (band_pct 100) and duplicate/daily-limit rules not applied (out of scope).

steps: Identity: contract reference CW-2025-0417-CIV and subcontractor Ridgeway Civil Engineering LLC both match the Agreement (p1).
Window: period 2025-06-10 to 2025-06-10; application 2025-06-15, 5 days after period end (limit 21), not early; work date inside the period.
Unit: line m3 = Schedule 1 unit m3 for A.12.030 (p17) -> OK.

Record: A.12.030 requires a Daily Excavation Record, series DX (Schedule 5, p27). DX-90058 quoted: series DX correct; date 10/06/2025 = work date; signed by foreman and countersigned by Engineer's representative (Cl.47); describes 'trench dig 100 cube, 3 m deep section' = trench excavation 2 m to 4 m, 100 m3 -> evidences A.12.030 and 100 m3.

Record work area: 'S-02 Platform South'; line is for S-01 Platform North -> record_area_mismatch. No record for S-01 on 2025-06-10 has been delivered, so under Cl.46/Sch 5 the item is not payable: allowed_quantity 0.
Rate in force: Schedule 1 A.12.030 = 47.60 (p17); no instrument changes A.12.030 (p38-43).

Build-up (Cl.27): 47.60 x zone Z1 factor 1 (Series A, p20) = 47.60; x ground G2 factor 1 (A.12.030 listed in Sch 3, p23; the line leaves ground class blank, the DX record gives G2 Firm Sabkha, and S4 would default to G2 anyway, p10) = 47.60; night N -> no night uplift; 2025-06-10 Tuesday -> no rest-day uplift (A.12.030 not in Sch 4 Part 2 anyway, p24); A.12.030 not banded in Sch 4 Part 3 (band_pct 100) -> 47.60.
Amount: 0 x 47.60 = 0.00 (not payable). Had the record matched the area: 100 x 47.60 = 4760.00.
Billed rate 47.60 = unit_rate -> no rate_differs; billed 100 x 47.60 = 4760.00 = billed amount -> no amount_arithmetic.
